description: RUP municipal "Dam West" (Anvers) is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stadt Antwerpen. Dates relating to the Spatial Implementation Plan "Dam West" in Antwerp.Together with this RUP, an expropriation plan was also approved (ONT110022521015200001). Coverage: Stadt Antwerpen. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal RUP "Dam West" (Antwerp)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stadt Antwerpen. Its keywords include PLANNENREGISTER, BESTEMMINGEN, PLAN, RUP ANTWERPEN, ANTWERPEN, RUIMTELIJKE PLANNING. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
